codeSystems.name: FijiAllergyAgentVS
codeSystems.title: Allergy Causative Agent Value Set for Fiji Patient
codeSystems.description: A subset of SNOMED CT concepts representing substances or products that cause allergies or intolerances, aligned with global IPS.

codeSystems.name: FijiBodySiteVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Body Site (Anatomical Structure) Value Set
codeSystems.description:
Valueset for bodysite/anatomical structures.
Used for Condition.bodySite
Values from SNOMED CT anatomical structures.

codeSystems.name: FijiConditionCodeVS
codeSystems.title: Condition/Diagnosis code valueset
codeSystems.description:
Condition Code valueset for Fiji Core. 
Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED codes curated for International Patient Summary.
Includes "clinical finding"  codes and codes for "situation with explicit content".

codeSystems.name: FijiEvidenceVS
codeSystems.title: Condition Evidence Value Set for Fiji Core IG
codeSystems.description: Evidence: Signs, symptoms, procedures, and labs, explicitly excluding formal diseases.

codeSystems.name: FijiRadiologyFindingsVS
codeSystems.title: Fiji Radiology/Diagnostic Findings Value Set
codeSystems.description: Fiji radiology findings including SNOMED CT concepts filtered for radiology and imaging findings used within an IPS context.

codeSystems.name: HeartRateVS
codeSystems.title: Heart Rate LOINC Codes
codeSystems.description: LOINC codes for heart rate measurements, spot or average.
